''See also: [[ghost armor Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Ghost]] armor is a spectral, translucent green protective layer that can be summoned by certain individuals. It manifests as luminous plates of light and is specifically designed to defend against the supernatural abilities of other [[Travelers]], such as fireballs or lightning bolts. However, it offers no protection against physical weapons like arrows, swords, or spears. To obtain this armor, one must undergo a trial in a [[graveyard]]—a location established by the [[The Wanderer|Wanderer]]—which involves surviving attacks until a designated time period expires. The process of summoning it requires the user to reach out to [[Valinhall]] for strength at a moment when they truly believe they are facing death. While the armor can be called upon to block intense magical pressure, it is a finite resource that users must manage carefully to avoid depletion during combat.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Earned within the [[graveyard]], ghost armor serves as a defense against the supernatural powers of other [[Travelers]]. While it can block specific magical threats, such as [[Lirial]]'s stars, the armor offers no protection against mundane weapons like swords, spears, or arrows. [[Simon]] identifies this spectral green equipment as a vital goal and potential reward for his journey. The armor responds to those who reach out to [[Valinhall]] for power, a capability shared by [[Indirial]] and eventually [[Simon]] himself.}}
